name: vfx-portal
title: Portal Reveal
description: A landing page tears open from the centre in a glowing, colour-cycling portal and the dark theme of the same page is revealed behind it, with chromatic aberration and edge distortion along the rim. WebGL shader over two built-in pages (light and dark).
useWhen: A light-to-dark theme reveal for a product or app: the page tears open and the dark UI appears inside the portal.
Any before/after reveal that should feel like a glowing rift.
avoidWhen: You need to reveal your own scenes: the block plays between its two built-in pages; copy the shader and feed it your two frames as textures.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Brand name
variables.description: Logo text on both pages (a placeholder name).

variables.label: Accent
